entry.title: BILL049(24) (Honolulu): — → FILE
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Establishes a real property tax exemption for real property whose assessed valuations exceed an unspecified percentage of the previous tax year’s assessed value and for which a homeowner’s exemption has been claimed for an unspecified number of years. Allows the real property tax exemption to continue to apply if the real property is inherited in sole ownership by a single family member who is eligible for the home exemption with respect to that real property, and the real property continues to be held in sole ownership. Effective upon the enactment of certain State legislation.

entry.title: BILL046(24) (Honolulu): — → FILE
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Establishes an empty homes tax as a supplemental real property tax on dwelling units that are vacant for a certain number of days each year and provides exemptions from the empty homes tax. Requires residential property owners to annually submit a property status declaration. Provides the Department of Budget and Fiscal Services with rulemaking authority. Establishes violations and penalties, including foreclosure of real properties having delinquent empty homes taxes and penalties for at least three consecutive years after notice.
